objective: Scientifically and operationally govern lot-relative anomaly detection, reference population quality, provenance exposure, and zero-leakage test lot evaluation.

data_lineage.synthetic_disclosure: Benchmark results and models are based on synthetic semiconductor simulation data. Results do not guarantee external real-world silicon qualification until independently validated on physical fab lot telemetry.

SUFFICIENT_KNOWN_LOT.condition: Known lot present in training reference store with sample_count >= minimum_reference_population_size and passing quality checks
SUFFICIENT_KNOWN_LOT.description: Component evaluated against validated lot-specific robust median and MAD distribution.

UNDERSIZED_KNOWN_LOT.condition: Known lot in training reference store with sample_count < minimum_reference_population_size
UNDERSIZED_KNOWN_LOT.description: Lot population is too sparse for statistically valid lot baseline. Safely falls back to global reference.

UNSEEN_LOT.condition: Lot identifier not present in training reference store (e.g. held-out test lots, future production lots)
UNSEEN_LOT.description: Lot was not seen during model fitting. Evaluated against global reference without fabricated lot baseline.

MISSING_OR_EMPTY_LOT.condition: lot_id is null, missing, empty string, or whitespace
MISSING_OR_EMPTY_LOT.description: Missing lot identifier defaults to global baseline reference.

INVALID_OR_DEGENERATE_REFERENCE.condition: Lot reference population fails reference quality checks (zero/near-zero robust scale, constant features, non-finite values)
INVALID_OR_DEGENERATE_REFERENCE.description: Degenerate or contaminated reference population intercepted. Safely falls back to global reference.

INVALID_INPUT.condition: Input payload violates feature schema (missing, extra, or out-of-order canonical features, non-numeric or non-finite values)
INVALID_INPUT.description: Schema violation triggers immediate exception rejection.

contamination_evaluation.description: Contamination beyond robust dispersion checks (zero MAD/sigma and non-finite checks) is not evaluated or claimed.

leakage_and_immutability_governance.test_lot_leakage_protection: Held-out test lots (LOT-SYN-043 through LOT-SYN-050) are strictly unseen during training and must not have lot reference statistics constructed from test observations. They must execute via UNKNOWN_LOT / GLOBAL_FALLBACK path.
leakage_and_immutability_governance.reference_store_immutability: Scoring is strictly read-only. Evaluating samples from any lot must never add, modify, or cache lot statistics in the reference store.
leakage_and_immutability_governance.determinism: Scoring identical inputs must always produce identical scores, statuses, and reference provenance.
